messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert P-12345 fired to rotation 'oncall-sre' (Jamie). Summary: eu-west2/az2 serving degradation — sustained 5xx surge and token latency spike across serving pool. Metric highlights: 502 rate +12% in last 2m, p95 token latency 820ms. Links: https://monitoring.redwood.internal/alerts/P-12345

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty P-12345 created and notifications sent. Urgency: high. Escalation policy: standard-sre -> eng-platform after 8m if unacked.

Jamie (oncall-sre): acked. I'm taking it. A quick check: are we seeing any recent deploys in eu-west2?

Omar (oncall-operator): no deploys in last 30m. I'm pulling serving host telemetry now. Seeing repeated OOM-kill + image pull backlog on az2-hosts-5 group.

Jamie (oncall-sre): copying runbook. Triage steps: 1) check autoscaler 2) check node health 3) route diversion if capacity constrained. Running: 
```sh
kubectl -n serving get hpa,svc -l region=eu-west2 -o wide
# output: hpa serving-frontend scaleTarget=deployment/serving-frontend currentReplicas=24 desired=24
```

Omar (oncall-operator): digging into node metrics: disk_pressure and kubelet eviction spikes around 01:01Z on several az2 VMs. Example from host az2-hosts-5-7:
```
Mar 15 01:01:12 kubelet[...]: Eviction threshold reached: eviction_thresholds: imagefs.available
Mar 15 01:01:12 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 2345 (model_worker)
```

Lina (eng-platform): if nodes are under disk pressure the autoscaler won't provision new pods reliably. Recommend routing fallback to eu-west1 and scaling reserved pool for eu-west2 while we remediate. Propose immediate policy: divert 30% traffic from eu-west2 -> eu-west1 for read-heavy routes, and enable fallback model-variant with lower memory footprint for az2.

Jamie (oncall-sre): running routing divert now (will do 30% split):
```sh
reconfigure-routing --from eu-west2 --to eu-west1 --split 30 --routes "/api/v1/generate,/api/v1/chat"
# CLI returns: OK: traffic split applied, id=split-9876
```

incident-bot: routing-split applied (id=split-9876) — 30% diverted from eu-west2 to eu-west1. Observability: generating new dashboards.

Sarah (support-lead): customer impact check: support telemetry shows ~4.1% of EU traffic experiencing 5xx in last 5m, top affected tenants: AcmeCorp (+420 errors), Finlytics (+190 errors). Notifying account reps.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty update: P-12345 ack by Jamie at 01:03Z. Next escalation to eng-platform scheduled at 01:11Z if unresolved.

Lina (eng-platform): I'm on the page. I'm initiating quick capacity bump: will attempt to increase reserved GPU pool capacity for eu-west2 by +4 nodes (manual scale). If provisioning fails, fallback model variant will be rolled for incoming requests.

Omar (oncall-operator): attempting node add now, hitting provisioning errors: cloud API returns 429 for several AZ allocation attempts. Error: "Insufficient capacity in az2 for requested instance type". Looks like capacity shortage in az2 region.

Jamie (oncall-sre): ok — autoscaler and cloud are constrained. We should enable graceful degrade: increase request timeouts and enable retry fallback for clients to reduce spike pressure and avoid large token churn. Lina, can you flip the model-variant flag?

Lina (eng-platform): flipping flag to variant-light for affected routes. YAML applied:
```yaml
service: serving-frontend
routeModifiers:
  - path: /api/v1/generate
    modelVariant: variant-light
    rollout: 100%
```
Rollback plan: revert in 1h if errors increase.

incident-bot: model-variant rollout started for /api/v1/generate (variant-light). Observability: flagged under rollout id rv-20260315-1.

Omar (oncall-operator): after routing split + model-variant change we're seeing a drop in p95 latency to ~540ms and 5xx rate decreasing to ~2.6%. But cloud provisioning for extra nodes still failing due to AZ-level capacity.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation: Auto-escalating P-12345 to eng-platform (Lina) due to ongoing impact.

Lina (eng-platform): I'll coordinate with capacity team to request cross-AZ provisioning and long-term drain of unhealthy nodes. For now, leave split active and keep variant-light. Also recommending enabling short-term rate-limiting per-tenant for the worst affected customers (AcmeCorp). Sarah, can support send targeted notices?

Sarah (support-lead): on it. Sending templated message to AcmeCorp & Finlytics now, will CC account execs. Message: "We're seeing transient serving degradations in eu-west2 which may affect requests. We've applied mitigations (traffic diversion, lower-memory model variant) and will update in 30 minutes."

Jamie (oncall-sre): manual mitigation checklist: 
- [x] acked and triaged
- [x] routing split applied (30%)
- [x] model-variant light rolled
- [x] support notified
- [ ] capacity team engaged for cross-AZ provisioning

Omar (oncall-operator): adding note: node drain in az2 is risky now because cloud can't replace instances. Recommend we avoid mass drains; instead cordon and gradually migrate traffic via routing split.

Lina (eng-platform): agreed. I'm taking lead on next steps — capacity ticket created (CT-8842) and contacting cloud provider for soft quota. Jamie, I'll take a 20m handoff once I have capacity confirmation.

Jamie (oncall-sre): handing off to Lina for follow-through. I'm switching primary oncall to Omar for 20m while Lina coordinates with capacity. Leaving incident as P2 since partial outage with mitigations in place.

incident-bot: On-call handoff recorded: from Jamie -> Lina @ 01:10Z. Handoff notes: routing split 30%, variant-light active, customer notices sent, capacity ticket CT-8842 opened.

pagerduty-bot: P-12345: next reminder scheduled in 12m. If degradation continues or reverts, escalate to oncall-sre lead.

Sarah (support-lead): will keep support channel open and update customers at 01:40Z or earlier if situation changes.

Lina (eng-platform): noted. After capacity confirmation we may revert split to 10% and gradually return to normal. Post-incident actions: full postmortem, add autoscaler checks for imagefs pressure, and add runbook step to prefer cross-AZ provisioning earlier.

Jamie (oncall-sre): thanks everyone. Marking thread as active. I'll compile timeline for handoff notes.

-- end of thread (for now) --
